answer: An operator leases one numbered loom loft at a mill roof's zenith. Only that holder may warp a uniquely lot-tagged skein of raven wool and, at an unannounced shift bell, weave a one-shot length of whisper gauze into the official sample book. Graders match loft key, dye lot, swatch hash, and the bell clock. A shared loft, a leftover skein, or an off-bell weave is forfeited as one farm. Fielding N aliases costs N exclusive lofts, N unique skeins, and N live shift-bell weaves no single weaver can stack in the same hour.
